purpose: Official company domains accepted as PRIMARY sources for `bf-news --class none_found` (company IR / disclosure pages). Matched on the domain or any subdomain (ir.<domain>, cdn.<domain>), never as a substring. Exchange/regulator hosts (hsx.vn, hnx.vn, ssc.gov.vn, vsd.vn ...) are always primary and are not listed here.
